notes.title: Rescue Agency: The Kidnapper of happiness is out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Go towards adventure and magic![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43806311/3b8382247ab5ea96b80f5cbe82707d1a8ece67c7.png[/img]


GameMixer studio gives you an unforgettable trip to the Mysterious Land together with a courageous Fairy!

[b]FEATURES:[/b]
[list]
[*]Global map with production and rare resources
[*]30 unique and challenging missions
[*]Challenging achievements to unlock
[*]Beautiful exclusive concept art available for download
[*]Step-by-step strategy guide
[*]Unique collectibles
[*]Stories and legends of the Abonda
[*]Breathtaking author's music
[/list]
